title: Search-o1: Agentic Search-Enhanced Large Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Xiaoxi Li, Guanting Dong, Jiajie Jin, Yuyao Zhang, Yujia Zhou, Yutao Zhu, Peitian Zhang, Zhicheng Dou
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: Search-o1 interleaves QwQ-32B-Preview reasoning with live top-10 web retrieval and a separate Reason-in-Documents rewrite, but releases no versioned trajectory corpus or web snapshot.
Search-o1 在推理时生成查询、检索网页并压缩文档内容；它是推理时搜索框架而非训练轨迹发布。
why: It exposes a useful test-time trace schema and transformation boundary between raw retrieval and model-written evidence, while making replay, provenance, and rights gaps explicit.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: queries retrieved snippets and document-reasoning rewrites.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Search-o1 addresses reasoning tasks in which a long chain encounters facts absent from the model's parameters. The object relevant to this track is an inference episode, not a training corpus: task instruction and question, partial reasoning, a model-issued query, ranked web results and page content, a document-conditioned rewrite, resumed reasoning, and the final answer.

The paper asks how retrieval can be invoked at the point of uncertainty without flooding the reasoning context with long, noisy pages. The official project and repository provide a runnable scaffold; they do not establish a released, versioned collection of experimental rollouts.

Search-o1 面向长推理过程中遇到参数知识缺口的任务。与本赛道相关的对象是推理时 episode，而不是训练语料：任务指令与问题、已有推理、模型发出的查询、排序后的网页结果与页面内容、基于文档的重写、继续推理和最终答案。

论文关注如何在不确定点触发检索，同时避免把冗长、噪声较多的页面直接塞入推理上下文。官方项目页与仓库提供可运行脚手架，但未证明实验 rollout 已作为带版本的数据集合发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
QwQ-32B-Preview may emit a query between begin-search-query and end-search-query. Search-o1 pauses generation, retrieves results, and invokes Reason-in-Documents with the reasoning prefix, query, and fetched pages. That separate pass first analyzes the pages and then emits compact refined knowledge, inserted between result delimiters before main reasoning resumes. The cycle may repeat.

The important data boundary is raw retrieval versus model-written refinement. Reason-in-Documents is a transformation, not a factuality verifier: the final benchmark answer is scored, but the query, source choice, page claims, and refined block do not receive independent quality labels.

QwQ-32B-Preview 可在 begin-search-query 与 end-search-query 之间输出查询。Search-o1 暂停生成、执行检索，并把推理前缀、查询和抓取页面交给 Reason-in-Documents。该独立生成过程先分析页面，再输出紧凑的精炼知识，以结果定界符插回上下文，随后主推理继续；此循环可重复。

关键数据边界是原始检索与模型重写后的精炼知识。Reason-in-Documents 是转换器而非事实性 verifier：最终 benchmark 答案会被评分，但查询、来源选择、网页主张和精炼块没有独立质量标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reported backbone is QwQ-32B-Preview. Generation uses a 32,768-token maximum, temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, top-k 20, and repetition penalty 1.05. Retrieval calls Bing Web Search in US-EN with top 10 results; Jina Reader fetches readable page content. Batch inference advances each sequence until EOS or a search delimiter, batches pending retrieval/refinement work, inserts the refined result, and continues. If no final answer is produced, evaluation backs off to direct reasoning.

A reusable record should separate instruction, question, reasoning prefix, query, ranked result IDs, raw snippets/pages, Reason-in-Documents analysis, refined knowledge, resumed reasoning, terminal answer, and fallback/tool-error state. The paper does not report a maximum search-call count, seeds, retained rollout count, page snapshots, or a corpus-level selection rule.

报告使用 QwQ-32B-Preview；生成上限为 32,768 token，temperature 0.7、top-p 0.8、top-k 20、repetition penalty 1.05。检索调用 US-EN 区域的 Bing Web Search 并取前 10 个结果，Jina Reader 抓取可读页面。批处理循环让各序列生成到 EOS 或查询定界符，批量完成检索与精炼，再插回结果继续生成；若没有最终答案，评测会回退到直接推理。

可复用记录应分别保存指令、问题、推理前缀、查询、排序结果 ID、原始摘要/页面、Reason-in-Documents 分析、精炼知识、续写推理、终局答案以及回退/工具错误状态。论文未报告最大搜索次数、随机种子、保留 rollout 数、网页快照或语料级筛选规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper evaluates five challenging reasoning surfaces—GPQA, MATH500, AMC2023, AIME2024, and an August-November 2024 LiveCodeBench slice—and six open-domain QA benchmarks: Natural Questions, TriviaQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle. Comparisons include direct reasoning, standard RAG, an agentic RAG baseline, and Search-o1; the paper also varies retrieval depth.

These experiments support claims about the tested inference scaffold and the contribution of retrieval/refinement under stated settings. They are not record-level validation of retrieved pages or refined knowledge, and they do not establish a reusable dataset's coverage, rights, deduplication, or factual accuracy.

官方论文在五类复杂推理评测面上测试：GPQA、MATH500、AMC2023、AIME2024，以及 2024 年 8 至 11 月的 LiveCodeBench 子集；开放域问答则包括 Natural Questions、TriviaQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 和 Bamboogle。比较对象包括直接推理、标准 RAG、agentic RAG 基线与 Search-o1，论文还改变了检索深度。

这些实验支持对特定设置下推理脚手架及检索/精炼作用的判断，但不是对逐条网页或精炼知识的验证，也不能证明可复用数据集的覆盖、权利、去重或事实准确性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The useful direction signal is the explicit interleaving schema plus an intermediate evidence-rewrite boundary. Standard RAG retrieves once for the original question; the agentic baseline retrieves during reasoning; Search-o1 additionally transforms pages into reasoning-specific knowledge before reinsertion. This makes it possible to audit what the model searched, what it saw, and what another model pass chose to expose.

Agentic RAG, document compression, and long-chain reasoning are not individually new. The contribution is their orchestration for an o1-style inference loop and the batch execution recipe. It should be catalogued as a construction recipe and test-time environment, not promoted to an open trace dataset.

有价值的方向信号是显式交错模式，以及中间证据重写边界。标准 RAG 只针对原问题检索一次；agentic 基线在推理中检索；Search-o1 进一步把网页转换成面向当前推理的知识再插回。由此可以分别审计模型搜索了什么、看到了什么，以及另一轮模型生成选择暴露了什么。

Agentic RAG、文档压缩和长链推理并非分别由该工作首创；贡献在于面向 o1 风格推理循环的编排和批处理配方。它应归为构造方法与测试时环境，而不应升级为开放轨迹数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No raw rollout corpus, immutable result manifest, page snapshot, document-level licence record, or trace-level attribution ledger is released. Live results change with query time, region, indexing, and page revisions. Bing/Jina failures, blocked pages, and fallback frequency are not quantified.

Reason-in-Documents can omit, distort, or synthesize claims, and the paper reports no human or citation-level audit of those blocks. Top-10 retrieval may miss necessary evidence. The 32,768-token cap and direct-reasoning fallback create distinct terminal paths that should not be conflated. Benchmark accuracy remains model-behavior evidence, not proof that intermediate data are clean or redistributable.

论文未发布原始 rollout 语料、不可变结果清单、页面快照、逐文档许可记录或轨迹级归因账本。真实检索会随查询时间、区域、索引和页面版本变化；Bing/Jina 失败、被阻断页面及回退频率也未量化。

Reason-in-Documents 可能遗漏、扭曲或合成主张，论文没有报告对这些知识块的人工或引文级审计。Top-10 检索也可能漏掉必要证据。32,768 token 上限与直接推理回退形成不同终局路径，不应混为一类。Benchmark 准确率仍只是模型行为证据，不能证明中间数据洁净或可再分发。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For rollout_search_test_time_trace_data, Search-o1 is a reference design for tool-augmented trace capture. Log the prompt and split, policy checkpoint, every reasoning segment, query, ranked result ID, retrieval timestamp, page revision/hash, raw page, refinement prompt/analysis/output, tool error, fallback, final answer, and metric. Keep raw evidence distinct from derived text.

A training adaptation could study query policy, evidence compression, failure recovery, or outcome-conditioned selection. Before reuse, pin the search/crawler stack, audit document rights, add span-level attribution and factuality checks, preserve unsuccessful searches, and avoid labeling every intermediate step as good merely because the final answer is correct.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 而言，Search-o1 可作为工具增强轨迹采集的参考设计。应记录 prompt 与 split、policy checkpoint、每段推理、查询、排序结果 ID、检索时间、页面版本/hash、原始页面、精炼 prompt/分析/输出、工具错误、回退、最终答案和指标，并始终区分原始证据与派生文本。

训练改造可研究查询策略、证据压缩、失败恢复或按结果选择。复用前应固定搜索/抓取栈，审计文档权利，加入片段级归因与事实性检查，保留失败搜索；不能因最终答案正确，就把所有中间步骤标成高质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Search-o1 as an inference-system recipe, not a training-corpus release.
  • Separate Bing/Jina pages from the Reason-in-Documents analysis and refined block.
  • Record 32,768 tokens, temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, top-k 20, and top-10 retrieval as experimental settings.
  • Treat direct-reasoning fallback as a separate terminal path.
  • Audit replayability, attribution, factuality, and source rights before collecting derivative traces.

• 将 Search-o1 视为推理系统配方，而不是训练语料发布。
  • 区分 Bing/Jina 页面、Reason-in-Documents 分析与精炼知识块。
  • 把 32,768 token、temperature 0.7、top-p 0.8、top-k 20 和 top-10 检索记录为实验设置。
  • 将直接推理回退视为独立终局路径。
  • 采集派生轨迹前审计可回放性、归因、事实性和来源权利。
